body.intent: Rhiza's Go behaviour moves into its own workflows: workflows can set environment variables (Rhiza's set GOTMPDIR to the run's temp folder), Rhiza's cleanup phase trims the Go build cache and stale go-build and rhiza test temp folders, Rhiza's ship-change workflow builds rhiza from the PR head in a step; trimGoCache, gosweep's daemon use, the product's GOTMPDIR and ship's is-Rhiza-repo check leave the product.
